scope: All45 existing faction AI lists plus11 generic instant-action strategies;9 colonizer-capable faction start files. Campaign-specific mission AI lists are not rewritten.
limitations: Static build lists cannot guarantee that every nearby resource is occupied before any combat production; native resource-site availability and priorities control placement.
Nearby resources favored10x more strongly; this is a preference, not a hard maximum distance.
No ordinary metal/dilithium colonies added to8472; it cannot colonize.
Borg and Breen have no native trading station; their later Ferengi expansion remains intact.
There is no separate Ferengi faction AI build-list set; Ferengi default starts still receive their colony ship.
